description.zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。</props>
description.en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID exists, you must specify this ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail.</props>

<props="china">
> If your public instance does not have an ID, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

description.zh:
项目名称。
- 支持中文、英文字母、数字、下划线（_）、短划线（-）、英文圆括号（()）。
- 必须以中文、英文字母或数字开头。
- 长度不超过30个字符（一个中文算一个字符）。
description.en:
The project name.
- Supports Chinese characters, English letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and English parentheses ().
- Must start with a Chinese character, English letter, or digit.
- The length cannot exceed 30 characters (one Chinese character counts as one character).

description.zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。默认为1。
description.en: The page number from which to start displaying results. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的条数。最小值1，最大值50，默认值20。
description.en: The number of entries to display per page in the return result. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 20.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制说明
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account when calling this API is 5.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot query-studio-project-list --name test1 --page-no 1 --page-size 20 --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
